title: Projective space over a ring is separated over the ring
statement: Let $A$ be a ring, $n\ge0$, and $P=\operatorname{Proj}(A[x_0,\dots,x_n])$ [def-pc-proj] ($\deg x_k=1$), with structure morphism $q:P\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ (on each standard open $D_+(x_k)=\operatorname{Spec}(A[x_0,\dots,x_n]_{(x_k)})$ it is induced by the ring map $A\to A[x_0,\dots,x_n]_{(x_k)}$). Then $q$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism].

source.place: Constructions, Lemma 01NH (constructions-lemma-projective-space-separated) part (1), with P^n_{Spec A} = Proj(A[T_0,...,T_n]) by Lemma 01O3 (constructions-lemma-relative-proj-base-change); the proof is that of Lemma 01MC (constructions-lemma-proj-separated) relative to Spec of the degree-0 part
